results.focus: Beginner with 2 h/week and a verified 14-day deadline

tasks.title: Define one clear user journey for the demo
tasks.deliverable: One-paragraph user story plus numbered click-by-click flow for adding and completing a task
tasks.completionCriteria: Flow lists start state, user actions, and visible outcome for add, list, and complete; scope notes frontend-only with no backend work

tasks.title: Draft static page structure for task list
tasks.deliverable: Single HTML draft with input, add button, and task list area
tasks.completionCriteria: Draft renders entry field, add control, and list area with complete and remove controls; structure matches the defined flow

tasks.title: Add core task interactions in the browser
tasks.deliverable: Working draft where a user can add, mark complete, and remove tasks in the browser
tasks.completionCriteria: Defined flow can be clicked through: new task appears, completes with visible state change, and can be removed in the same session

tasks.title: Rehearse narrated demo walkthrough
tasks.deliverable: Short narrated script and practice notes for showing the user journey
tasks.completionCriteria: Script covers each step of the defined flow and what to show if a step does not respond as expected

candidate.explanation: Scoped to goal g-beginner with one demonstrable frontend-only flow: add a task, see it in a list, mark it complete. Critical path in dependency order: 1 define user journey, 2 draft static structure, 3 add core interactions, 4 rehearse walkthrough. Estimates include time to learn unfamiliar browser scripting. Optional work to defer: styling polish, persistence across reloads, filters, accounts, and backend storage. If the retained work still cannot fit reported constraints, decide whether to narrow the demo further, adjust available time or support, and request re-estimation; the application will assess timing from retained work.

flags: Estimated workload exceeds reported capacity. Review a minimum demo scope, dependency-ordered critical path, optional deferrals and a concrete scope/availability decision. Include learning time; do not shrink real effort, omit mandatory work or claim the fallback fits.

tasks.title: Draft clarification checklist for criteria and participation conditions
tasks.deliverable: Written clarification checklist of open questions about criteria and participation conditions to confirm via organizer-confirmed channel
tasks.completionCriteria: Checklist lists open questions covering the reported constraints and marks all items as pending confirmation with no assumptions recorded as facts

tasks.title: Map possible preparation directions for exploration
tasks.deliverable: Brief outline of possible preparation directions linked to the exploration goal
tasks.completionCriteria: Outline lists 2-3 possible preparation directions with information still needed for each and is marked exploratory only

candidate.explanation: Two small exploratory tasks tied to the exploration goal. The first creates a clarification checklist addressing the reported unverified criteria and participation conditions, with confirmation through an organizer-confirmed channel as a prerequisite. The second maps possible preparation directions without assuming a schedule. No reviewed requirements apply so no must tasks are used. Estimates are untimed guidance only; scheduling is handled by the application.
